summary_en: 56,000 shares (2.05% of shares outstanding) to be acquired via open market, up to ¥200M ceiling, execution window 16 July–15 December 2026. Stated rationale: preparation for M&A strategy and capital/business alliances.
title_en: Notice of Resolution on Matters Concerning Acquisition of Own Shares
translation_en_brief: Last One Mile Co., Ltd. announced on 15 July 2026 that its board of directors has resolved to acquire up to 56,000 shares of its own common stock via open-market purchase under Article 156 of the Companies Act (as applied by Article 165, paragraph 3). The acquisition is authorized through 15 December 2026, with a total yen ceiling of ¥200 million and a price ceiling per share not separately disclosed. The company states the purpose is to prepare for future M&A activities and capital-alliance partnerships. As of 14 July 2026, the company held 76,789 treasury shares and had 2,733,412 shares outstanding (excluding treasury); the 56,000-share authorization represents 2.05% of that outstanding base.
